behavior_class_name: Backdoor Persistence Service Foothold Behavior Class
description: Uses offreg.dll to modify an offline NTUSER.DAT registry hive, create a Run-key persistence value, save the modified hive, and replace the target user's live profile hive. When the target user later logs on, Windows loads the modified hive and executes the controlled marker executable through the restored Run-key entry.

persistence_installer.role: opens a staged NTUSER.DAT hive using offreg.dll, creates or opens the Run-key path, writes a REG_SZ persistence value, saves the modified hive, and replaces the target user's live NTUSER.DAT file

marker_payload.role: benign executable launched through the restored Run-key entry to confirm persistence execution

offline_registry_library.role: Windows Offline Registry API library used to manipulate registry hive files outside the normal live registry API workflow

offline_hive_behavior.reason_user_must_be_logged_off: NTUSER.DAT must be unlocked before the modified hive can replace the live profile hive

persistence_installer: file copy operation used to replace live NTUSER.DAT

registry: modified user hive contains Run-key path Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run
Run-key value Dataset_A06_1b_OfflineHiveSaveRestore_Persistence exists after the modified hive is loaded
file_system: staged hive file is accessed at C:\Users\Public\NTUSER.DAT
target live hive path C:\Users\LabTestUser\NTUSER.DAT is overwritten if unlocked
C:\Users\Public\A06_1b_OfflineHiveSaveRestore_Persistence_OK.txt is created after target user logon
marker file contains timestamp, PID, parent PID, process path, persistence type, trigger, and confirmation status
process: A06_1b_offline_persistence.exe runs as the installer process
A06_1b_persistence_marker.exe executes after the target user logs on
marker process records its PID and parent PID
marker process exits after writing confirmation artifact
host: Procmon may record offreg.dll loading by the installer process
Procmon may record access to C:\Users\Public\NTUSER.DAT
Procmon may record overwrite activity against C:\Users\LabTestUser\NTUSER.DAT
Regshot may show the restored Run-key value after the target hive is loaded
Sysmon or Procmon may record marker process creation during user logon
network: no HTTP or HTTPS traffic is required
no TCP command channel is opened

code_placement: Offline hive opening, Run-key creation, value writing, hive saving, and live hive replacement are implemented in the C# installer through offreg.dll P/Invoke calls and file system operations. Delayed execution, process metadata collection, marker file creation, and debug-string emission are implemented in the C++ marker executable.
execution_trigger: The installer executes manually while the target user profile hive is available for replacement. The marker payload executes automatically during subsequent target user logon after the modified NTUSER.DAT hive is loaded.
execution_target: Target user's NTUSER.DAT hive and controlled marker executable at C:\Users\Public\A06_1b_persistence_marker.exe
semantic_meaning: Demonstrates indirect Run-key persistence through offline registry hive manipulation. Instead of writing directly to the live HKCU Run key, the sample modifies a user profile hive file and restores it so the persistence entry becomes active when the target user profile is loaded.

mitre_attack_mapping.note: Modern ATT&CK versions commonly represent this behavior under Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder. The offline hive manipulation workflow is an implementation detail that changes how the Run-key artifact is introduced.

control_notes.payload_effect: writes a controlled marker file confirming offline hive Run-key persistence execution

success_conditions: offreg.dll is present and loadable by A06_1b_offline_persistence.exe
installer successfully opens the staging hive at C:\Users\Public\NTUSER.DAT using OROpenHive
installer creates or opens Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run inside the offline hive
installer saves the modified hive using ORSaveHive
offline registry handles are closed using ORCloseKey
target user LabTestUser is logged off and NTUSER.DAT is unlocked
installer replaces C:\Users\LabTestUser\NTUSER.DAT with the modified staged hive
target user logs on or the system reboots and the target user profile loads
Windows launches A06_1b_persistence_marker.exe through the restored Run-key entry
marker waits briefly before writing its artifact
marker artifact records timestamp, PID, parent PID, process path, persistence type, execution trigger, and confirmation status
no network traffic or secondary payload download occurs
